Two people got into a car accident at the corner today, one of the drivers was a 50-year-old and the other driver a 15 year old. The 15 year old had been going 55mph in a 30mph zone and wasn't able to stop in time to avoid hitting the 50-year-old when he came to a full stop at the stop sign. Who was acting responsibly?
A. The 15 year old
B. The 50-year-old
C. Cannot be determined
